ranking: Reject incompatible distribution or unbounded state first; compare normalized WER on calibration, then heldout using unchanged settings. Prefer lower WER among native candidates that meet bounded processing/backlog and resource constraints. Do not call source-aligned speech latency passed using dispatch duration.
latencyPolicy: Increased cadence must be evaluated separately from the 1-second initial comparison. Missing source-aligned latency, cancellation, silence, or energy data remains unmeasured, not passed.
testPolicy: All five candidates get identical initial fixtures. Strongest two viable native candidates get the longer paced dual-source replay. Model/backend selection remains provisional until application integration, source-aligned latency, cancellation and soak requirements are verified.
